environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for observability, (2) a custom rule at priority 200 that applies a rate limit of 100 req/5min per IP to URI path '/api/user/search', and (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 300 in BLOCK mode. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch with a metric filter alarm on 4xx spike. The ECS task role has no network egress except to the ALB via security group (no internet-bound NAT). Container image is distroless Python.

config.security_group_egress: only to ALB SG on port 443, no NAT gateway, no internet route
